subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 05/10] mountd: retry unresolvable fsid lookups on the netlink downcall

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to retry unresolvable file system ID (fsid) lookups on netlink downcalls. The fsid lookup is moved out of nfsd_handle_fh() and into a separate function, lookup_fsid(). If the fsid cannot be resolved immediately, the request is deferred and retried at regular intervals. This change addresses issues with spurious ESTALE errors and improves handling of unmounted autofs submounts. The patch also includes additional error checking and logging to prevent denial-of-service attacks.
